articles.title: OpenAI launches ChatGPT desktop app for Linux
articles.description: OpenAI is finally bringing a dedicated ChatGPT desktop app to Linux operating systems.

articles.title: Brazil's largest lender Itaú is stepping deeper into the tokenization
articles.description: Itaú Unibanco said it teamed up with tokenization specialist OpenAssets to test tokenized bonds and funds in a pilot run by Brazil's financial watchdog ANBIMA.

articles.title: Google’s Gemini app surges to one billion users
articles.description: Gemini is keeping pace with OpenAI’s ChatGPT, which hit 1 billion monthly active users back in June.

articles.title: Strategy CEO says company will resume Bitcoin accumulation this year
articles.description: The company has bought roughly 25 times more BTC than it has sold this year, despite recent sales that challenged its long-standing accumulation strategy.

articles.title: ARP Digital secures Dubai VARA broker-dealer license
articles.description: The license allows ARP Digital to offer regulated digital asset and stablecoin conversions into UAE dirhams as it expands its Gulf presence beyond Bahrain.

articles.title: Bluesky’s active user base is shrinking as its focus expands beyond the app
articles.description: Over a year following its post-election surge, Bluesky’s mobile app is seeing a continued decline in active users, though its remaining community is still relatively engaged.

articles.title: Brad Lightcap, OpenAI’s longtime COO, is leaving to ‘start something new’
articles.description: One of OpenAI's longest-serving executives is headed out the door, although the longtime COO told staff that he was "excited to help you all advance the mission from a different vantage point."

articles.title: General Catalyst leads $1.1B round into 2-month-old River AI
articles.description: River AI, a startup founded by xAI co-founder Igor Babuschkin, has a fascinating vision for personal agents and secured $1.1 billion out of the gate.

articles.title: EToro reports second quarter crypto loss even as total profit beats estimates
articles.description: The trading platform’s gross crypto revenue fell to $1.35 billion in the second quarter. It also agreed to buy U.S. brokerage TradeZero for up to $231 million.

articles.title: FlightAware sues Kalshi over flight cancellation data
articles.description: The legal action against Kalshi focused on trademark infringement and injury to its reputation in addition to citing state authorities comparing the company’s contracts to gambling.

articles.title: Coinbase-backed Flowdesk secures full broker-dealer license in Dubai
articles.description: Flowdesk’s VARA approval follows its MiCA authorization in France as crypto firms build regulated operations across major global markets.

articles.title: Nasdaq to acquire LeveL Markets in push toward ‘always-on’ markets
articles.description: Nasdaq’s acquisition of the third-largest US alternative trading system comes as the exchange operator expands into tokenized securities and longer trading hours.

articles.title: An unreleased Anthropic model made progress on one of math’s biggest unsolved problems
articles.description: For more than 150 years, the Riemann hypothesis has stood as one of the major unsolved problems in mathematics. Anthropic hasn't solved it — but the company's models made more progress than you might expect.

articles.title: Bitcoin drops to one-week low as retail buys gold at highest prices since June
articles.description: Bitcoin price action sank to one-week lows ahead of US CPI data, while retail investors piled into gold ETFs and XAU/USD hit its highest levels in nine weeks.

articles.title: Delta investigating after someone set up fake Wi-Fi network mid-flight
articles.description: The Delta flight crew switched off the aircraft's legitimate Wi-Fi network for around 30 minutes due to the incident, according to a spokesperson.

articles.title: 2025’s most downloaded game, Block Blast!, is going ad-free on Apple Arcade
articles.description: Block Blast!, the most downloaded mobile game of 2025, is coming to Apple Arcade in September, where it will be ad-free.

articles.title: Rivian CEO RJ Scaringe is betting on EVs, robots, and autonomy all at once — he’ll explain why at Disrupt 2026
articles.description: Rivian's CEO RJ Scaringe is speaking at TechCrunch Disrupt 2026 to detail his journey, and the lessons it’s bestowed.

articles.title: Kyoto Fusioneering starts work on key fusion power plant device
articles.description: Fusion power startups are turning to Kyoto Fusioneering to supply components for future power plants. The Japan-based startup just received a grant to build a part of the fuel system.

articles.title: If crypto goes back to the congressional drawing board, 3 Democrat women loom large
articles.description: The Democrats who may get a bigger say in future crypto legislative efforts are familiar figures, and they generally look at digital assets with distrust.

articles.title: Crypto-friendly bank Erebor in talks to raise $1.5 billion at $9.5 billion valuation: FT
articles.description: Total deposits grew from $1.1 billion in March to $4.6 billion by July, driven by clients in crypto, AI and defense.
